prescription_boundary.focus_component_table_topology: Surface 1 publishes the focus-tunable component with per-mode CTt and ft; Surface 2 publishes the following axial spacing. Official PDF wrapper page 48 corroborates column occupancy only.
prescription_boundary.conversion_boundary: PatentSurface and PatentConversionRequest have no per-surface focal-length/ideal-power field. Omitting the component or deriving radius/material would lose or synthesize source truth, so all 20 optical modes remain precise nonterminal parser-review items.
